text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
a lone kitten hissed at me from the path.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't bare your fangs like that! 
Tsk, tsk, tsk...

Incredible... The kitten that was hissing 
with its fur standing on end just a moment 
ago is now showing its belly, purring 
docilely as Director Akikawa pets it.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There, there. This Kijiemon can be a bit 
rough around the edges, you see!
choice_data_list: Did you give it a name?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! As Director, paying heed to 
everyone connected to the Academy is only 
natural!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hence, every cat that settled on campus 
has been given a name! Working together 
with Tazuna and our volunteers, we monitor 
each and every one of them!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Especially kittensâsometimes we even 
adopt them out to good homes!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
To make it as friendly to people as 
possible, I shall fluff it daily! This too 
is the Director's duty!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Oho, everyone is here! Welcome! I shall 
bestow my affection upon each of you in 
turn!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm! Let us fluff them together! And then, 
train them! Let's raise an affectionate 
one!

Despite her busy schedule, she constantly 
looked out for everyone involved with the 
academy. It was a moment that offered a 
glimpse into Director Akikawa's profound 
generosity.
